name: Mitake Toujirou
source:
A reporter for the AOU Combined Military and Miyao's father.

[Spoiler]His real position is that of an intelligence officer of the AOU military, granted extralegal authority to take any action of his own volition that will serve the interests of the state. Furthermore, he is the leader of the Order of the Wisteria, manipulating things behind the scenes.
[/Spoiler]
